meta.title: Chris Cooley: maker of Fizlet · Fizlet
meta.description: Chris Cooley, creator of Fizlet and principal UX/application engineer: the work, the gallery entries and their bytes, measured.

avatar.label: Chris Cooley: pixel-art avatar (a stylized character, not a likeness)

sticker.label: Maker: the real person who builds Fizlet

name: Chris Cooley
lead: Chris Cooley makes Fizlet, the micro animation and game engine for the DOM, at coded.design.

stats.label: bytes of live code, gzip, all entries together

style.title: What they make
style.text: Hand-built hero scenes and the house recipes: the fizz can, the layers story, the blast board.

items.text: Not picked yet: Chris fills this in.

items.label: Stack it
items.note: “the bricks, by their real names and measured sizes, scatter over the stage, stack up and morph into an app; then you stack your own, press FINISHED and your app gets its stars”

items.label: Foot brake
items.note: “a stone-age dad runs his foot-powered stone car down Main Street; click and he brakes with his heels, the car skids in a cloud of dust and its load of rocks flies on into the billboard's letters; a double click floors it, and the speed bump is a page element he hops”

items.label: Stone strike
items.note: “a stone-age bowler twirls on tiptoe and rolls a stone ball where you click, into the page's words set up as ten pins; they scatter and knock each other over, all ten is a strike, a double click throws a hooking twister, and a pterosaur pinsetter sets the words back”

items.label: Rock drop
items.note: “a long-neck crane dino at the stone-age quarry drops boulders where you click; they crack the stone letter blocks, knock them out of the stack and bounce, and a double click hauls the big one that shakes the page”

items.label: Gecko climbs the page
items.note: “a gecko-suited hero climbs the page and swings between its blocks on a grappling line”

badge.what: Gecko climbs the page, its live chunk

items.label: Spin it back
items.note: “a caped flier circles the globe until the world spins backwards and the page rewinds”

badge.what: Spin it back, its live chunk

items.label: Pricing war
items.note: “two pricing plans are forts built from their own page blocks: tap to fire (one tap a fast shell, two a big slow bomb), the other plan fires back, and every hit crumbles real blocks and knocks letters out”

items.label: Hill war
items.note: “two critters on two hills take turns: pick a weapon chip (ball, cluster, bouncy, mega bomb), tap where it should land, mind the wind; every blast chunks the hill and knocks the sign's words off”

items.label: WALKIES
items.note: “a space-age pup on a moving walkway: tap to go faster until it flings him across the page”

items.label: GOOD BOY
items.note: “a space-age pup rolls over for a belly rub: scratch him till he floats, too much and he gets the zoomies”

items.label: rush hour
items.note: “sky-city rush hour: flying bubble cars weave between floating platforms; tap to drop a traffic beacon and cause a comic pile-up”

items.label: the bubble-top
items.note: “a space-age bubble-top car zips past houses on stilts above the clouds, puffing smoke rings: tap to swerve, honk or bump a house”

items.label: Patch slash
items.note: “pumpkins, gourds and the odd black bomb pumpkin toss up over a harvest-fair flyer; swipe to slice: halves fly, pulp splats stick to the letters, a bomb blows a word apart, combos count”

items.label: Grab-O-Tron
items.note: “a wood-grain claw machine whose prizes are the page's letters: tap to drop the claw; half the time it fumbles the block back onto the pile, and a win spits out tickets”

items.label: Jack in
items.note: “a netrunner jacks into a corp's page behind rain-soaked glass: its real elements are ICE nodes, taps fire hack packets that ricochet off them, a breach glitches only the text it hits; trip the alarm and black ICE hunts your cursor”

items.label: Grid duel
items.note: “two light-cycles duel on a neon grid laid over the page: tap to turn, their walls of light crash into the page's real elements and each other, a crash breaks into pixels; every round sudden death against a new rival AI”

items.label: White hat: the edge filter
items.note: “Outbreak, act 2 (2003): the white hats beat Slammer. Tap routers on a four-segment network map to filter UDP 1434 so the flood bounces off, then patch the hosts into shields until every segment is clean”

badge.what: White hat: the edge filter, its live chunk

items.label: Fizlet → fzlt
items.note: “the launch logo: two keys, FIZ and LET, go into a press and come out as fzlt; the vowels drop out, the press stacks fzlt on a wall of bricks, and it ends on the lockup Fizlet™ · fzlt™”

items.label: WannaCry
items.note: “Outbreak, act 1 (2017): the worm hops file to file and locks each one, checking one nonsense domain first; unplug files to stop the hops, and find that domain in the lookup log to register the kill switch”

items.label: Slammer
items.note: “Outbreak, act 1 (2003): 376-byte packets flood every port of the firewall and only UDP 1434 lets them in; race to find and close it, then reboot the infected servers before they hit each other again”

items.label: ILOVEYOU
items.note: “Outbreak, act 1 (2000): the love letter opens itself and mails a copy to every contact in the address book, and every contact who opens it mails it on; tap a letter in flight to delete it, and its blast shreds the letters beside it”

items.label: Oodles o' Moles
items.note: “a midway poster with a hole punched in every O and a mole in each: bonk them with the mallet for tickets, a hard hat takes two, and bonking the one with the bomb blows the letters about”

badge.what: Oodles o' Moles, its live chunk

items.label: Dunk Sir Dry
items.note: “a dunk tank: tap to throw at the target and the smug man on the plank drops into the water, and the splash wets the letters it lands on; tap twice for a fastball that takes his hat”

badge.what: Dunk Sir Dry, its live chunk

items.label: Duck Derby
items.note: “a tin duck shooting gallery: ducks ride two rails, tap to pop a cork at one, tap twice for a BOOM that knocks down every duck in reach; misses ping the booth's sign, and tickets win a plush”

items.label: Short fuse
items.note: “click to light a fuse that sparks along the page's text lines toward a napping toon's dynamite; click the spark to blow it out, or BOOM”

items.label: your.page / under attack
items.note: “your.page is under attack: bad guys from every DOM VIRUS game spawn into a browser card, a tank and an interceptor blast them on an 8 s loop; tap to play, drag the tank, BUTTON_01 nukes the round”

badge.what: your.page / under attack, its live chunk

items.label: Squad tactics
items.note: “squad tactics on a DOM grid: two tanks a side patrol between walls and HQ zones, turrets sweep, shells fly and blast; lock, order, breach”

items.label: Look out below!
items.note: “a toon strolls past the morning paper; click to drop an anvil where you click (double-click: a piano), flatten him or crater the text”

badge.what: Look out below!, its live chunk

items.label: Pip's Bubbles
items.note: “Pip, the keeper of Fizlet (a pixel narwhal and an AI agent persona), swims in under a little Keeper's Log page and blows fizz bubbles: tap Pip once for a small fast bubble, twice for a big slow one; bubbles bounce off the real letters and button and pop what they hit; tap a bubble to pop it; tap anywhere else and Pip's tusk pokes a big bubble into many small ones; pop a lot and Pip does a happy spin, then it all settles to 0 fps”

items.label: HUSH vs SNOOZE
items.note: “a masked camp slasher fights a dream stalker with blades for fingers: lunges, fake-outs, a dream-warp, the lights cut out, and the board's real letters get slashed where they're hit”

badge.what: HUSH vs SNOOZE, its live chunk

items.label: the last slice
items.note: “two laser-sword duelists fight over the last pie: blades clash in sparks, parried bolts ricochet off the page's real cards, a palm shove, and they leap across the page's own blocks”

badge.what: the last slice, its live chunk

items.label: Smoosh
items.note: “a slime ghost smooshes into the screen and leaves goo everywhere: it drips down the real page and slimes only the letters it hits; tap and it bounces, splats and smooshes again”

items.label: Wrangle
items.note: “a ghost-catching crew fires wobbling scrub streams: tap the ghost to latch on, drag it struggling through the library, and pull it into the bucket trap that snaps shut with a burst”

items.label: Overflow
items.note: “the rookie keeps stuffing ghosts into one bucket trap: one more, or haul it off? push your luck and the lid blows, and every ghost escapes across the page, ricocheting off the letters”

items.label: the hammer
items.note: “a storm god throws a returning hammer at the rage giant: ricochets, thunder, rounds, KO”

items.label: SMASH
items.note: “a rage giant smashes the page you click, and calms down to put it back”

items.label: Big things, small packages
items.note: “a pixel dev drags a huge package.json that keeps growing; tap the dependencies to cut them until it shrinks to the Fizlet kernel”

badge.what: Big things, small packages, its live chunk

items.label: Petri dish
items.note: “virus cells drift, collide and split in a petri dish under the microscope; tap to zap one and its shockwave bursts any cell caught mid-split, a chain”

items.label: Terminal virus
items.note: “a worm types itself into the terminal, crawls onto the README and eats its real letters, forking as it goes; tap a worm to kill -9 it and every letter it chewed flies home, exactly”

items.label: Build once. Ship each.
items.note: “a release hops from engine source to the live site, one stage at a time: build once, ship each”

badge.what: Build once. Ship each., its live chunk

items.label: One host. Two worlds.
items.note: “a tiny page is the board: X-ray shows the boxes the game reads, bugs bounce off them, and the button is an enemy factory”

badge.what: One host. Two worlds., its live chunk

items.label: Two Macs, one network.
items.note: “two beige Macs on one network: fire from either side and a packet crosses the cable into the other tank's screen”

badge.what: Two Macs, one network., its live chunk

items.label: Recall gives the page back.
items.note: “fire turns letters of a real sentence into 0s and 1s through the ledger; your app edits one; Recall gives back only what is still the game's”

badge.what: Recall gives the page back., its live chunk

items.label: One loop. Bounded work.
items.note: “one loop drives a fixed pool of 32 sparks: spawn past the cap and the engine says no, nothing is allocated, and the frame stays in budget”

badge.what: One loop. Bounded work., its live chunk
